title: HCI test case file
description: A list of RAG test cases. Retrieval checks run in pytest; answer checks run in `hci eval` (needs an LLM).

facts.description: Operator updates recorded before the question. They get ids fact-0, fact-1, ... in order.

retrieved.description: Chunk ids that must be in the context.

not_retrieved.description: Chunk ids that must not be in the context.

first.description: Chunk ids that must open the context, in this order.

answer_contains.description: Case-insensitive strings the LLM answer must all contain (hci eval only).

answer_excludes.description: Case-insensitive strings the LLM answer must not contain (hci eval only).

xfail.description: Known failure: the reason. The case still runs and is reported.
